description: Changes a plugin: name, settings (whole), patch (merged), form_html, status active or paused, or recipients {add: email} (an extra account inbox). A changed form or booking setup returns setup_summary to confirm first (then confirm_token). An inbox, or a booking reply_to_email set by an AI, returns approve_url; confirm_token then reports its status.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: after the person's yes to setup_summary, or the approve_url status

lang.description: The <html lang> of the page the snippet goes on (e.g. de): snippet_html then speaks it. One snippet per language on a multilingual site

patch.description: Merged onto the settings, e.g. {"approval":"always"}; null removes a key, arrays are replaced

add.description: An extra inbox for this kind of notification, for every site on the plan (needs permission to change access and settings)

settings.description: The whole settings object, shaped as list_plugins settings_help (forms too)

name: update_plugin
title: Change a plugin
